description.value: An Indian restaurant and sweets shop in Surrey's Newton neighbourhood, now operating under the name New Parmar Sweets & Catering, with a second South Surrey location recently added. The kitchen prepares a broad range of authentic subcontinental dishes daily — from street-food chaats and tandoori items to curries and Indo-Chinese fusion — alongside house-made fresh sweets. The dining hall seats up to 50 guests and the business offers online ordering and full event catering.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record names this business 'Bharat Parmar Restaurant' but the linked website is for 'New Parmar Sweets & Catering,' confirming a rebrand flagged in the URL discovery notes. The Newton location address on the website (13745 72 Ave #121B, Surrey, BC) matches the OSM address tags, confirming the same physical location; the website also supplies a phone number absent from OSM. No mention of bike parking, water refills, or washrooms appears anywhere in the website content, so all required criteria remain null.
